ast_normalizer.algorithm: recursive pre-order serialization of the CPython ast tree; every node emitted as its class name followed by its _fields in declaration order; positions and type comments dropped; all Constant nodes collapsed to a single opaque token; every identifier-bearing field (names, attributes, arguments, keyword labels, import aliases and modules, global/nonlocal/except/pattern bindings, type-parameter names) collapsed to a single opaque token; remaining structural integer and boolean flags preserved; node types, control-flow shape, operator nodes and nesting preserved
ast_normalizer.signature_input: normalizer id and version, then the normalized serialization

generation_method.commit_enumeration: revision list over the range, emitted oldest-first (reverse topological order)
generation_method.function_ordinal: 0-based index in a deterministic pre-order depth-first traversal restricted to function and async-function definitions, nested definitions included
generation_method.patch_id: stable patch id over the full-index textual diff of each commit
generation_method.python_candidate_selection: blobs observed at least once under a python source file extension suffix

scope.blob_selection_detail: blobs referenced by the collaborator tip tree or by any diff inside the commit range, minus blobs present in the merge-base tree, minus blobs present in the frozen-base commit tree
scope.signature_universe_for_allowlist: python blobs of the frozen-base commit tree
